vision: Autonomous multi-agent coding framework that plans, builds, and validates software for you

target_audience.primary: Professional software developers who want to accelerate their development workflow by delegating coding tasks to autonomous AI agents
secondary: Solo developers and indie hackers who need to multiply their productivity
Development teams looking for autonomous QA and code generation
Open-source maintainers who want AI assistance with issues and PRs
CI/CD pipeline operators needing headless AI-powered builds

phases.name: Foundation Enhancement
phases.description: Polish and strengthen core differentiating features that set Turret apart from competitors. Complete known technical gaps. Focus on making existing capabilities more robust, user-friendly, and reliable.

milestones.title: Memory Layer Excellence
milestones.description: Memory Layer provides intelligent context retrieval that demonstrably improves agent performance across sessions

milestones.title: Quality Assurance Completeness
milestones.description: QA pipeline catches 95%+ of common issues before code reaches user, with full merge completion recording and advanced conflict analysis

milestones.title: Frictionless Onboarding & Monitoring
milestones.description: New users can complete their first autonomous task within 10 minutes. Health monitoring keeps developers informed.

phases.name: User Experience Enhancement
phases.description: Improve the visual interface, workflow management, and developer experience. Make Turret more intuitive and powerful for daily use. Enable true fire-and-forget autonomous operation.

milestones.title: Visual Task Mastery
milestones.description: Kanban board and dashboard provide complete visibility into agent work with actionable insights

milestones.title: Workflow Automation
milestones.description: Users can define reusable task templates and automated workflows for common development patterns

milestones.title: Autonomous Resilience
milestones.description: System recovers from failures and coordinates multi-agent work without human intervention

phases.name: Scale & Performance
phases.description: Optimize for large codebases and heavy workloads. Reduce barriers to installation and improve resource efficiency. Deep integrations with development tools.

milestones.title: Enterprise-Ready Performance
milestones.description: Turret performs smoothly on codebases with 100,000+ files

milestones.title: Zero-Friction Installation
milestones.description: Installation requires no external dependencies (C++ compiler, specific Python version)

milestones.title: GitHub/GitLab Integration
milestones.description: End-to-end automation from issue to merged PR with deep Git platform integration

phases.name: Growth & Ecosystem
phases.description: Build extensibility, team collaboration, and ecosystem features for broader adoption and community growth. Enterprise-ready features.

milestones.title: Plugin Ecosystem Launch
milestones.description: Community can extend Turret with custom plugins, agents, and integrations

milestones.title: Team & Enterprise Ready
milestones.description: Teams can share configurations, memory, and workflows. Enterprise SSO and RBAC available.

features.title: Semantic Memory Search
features.description: Enhance the Memory Layer with semantic search capabilities that understand intent, not just keywords. Use embeddings to find relevant context even when exact terms differ. Prioritize recent and frequently-used memories.
features.rationale: Addresses a critical competitor pain point - Cursor, aider, and Claude Code CLI all lack persistent memory. This strengthens Turret's key differentiator and helps agents make better decisions by surfacing relevant past context.
acceptance_criteria: Given a natural language query, the system finds semantically similar memories even if wording differs
Memory relevance scores are visible to users
Agents automatically retrieve relevant memories when starting new tasks
Memory retrieval latency is under 500ms for typical queries
user_stories: As a developer, I want the agent to remember our architectural decisions so that it makes consistent choices across sessions
As a power user, I want to search my project memory using natural language so that I can verify what context the agent has

features.title: Memory Curation Dashboard
features.description: Build a visual interface for viewing, editing, and managing Memory Layer contents. Allow users to see what the AI remembers, correct inaccuracies, and add important context manually.
features.rationale: Provides transparency into what the agent knows and gives users control over the AI's learning, building trust and improving accuracy. Differentiates from closed-source black-box competitors like Devin.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view all stored memories in a searchable list
Each memory shows source, timestamp, and relevance to current project
Users can edit or delete individual memories
Users can manually add important context or corrections
Memory usage statistics are displayed (total count, categories)
user_stories: As a developer, I want to see what the AI remembers about my project so that I can verify it has correct context
As a team lead, I want to add project standards to the memory so that agents follow our conventions

features.title: Advanced Merge Completion Recording
features.description: Implement comprehensive tracking of merge operations including detailed conflict resolution history, success/failure metrics, and rollback capabilities. Store merge patterns for future reference. Addresses TODO at workspace.py line 141.
features.rationale: Listed as a known gap in the current system. Essential for audit trails and debugging merge issues. Helps agents learn from successful merge patterns and avoid repeating failed approaches.
acceptance_criteria: Every merge operation is logged with timestamp, files affected, and resolution details
Conflict resolution decisions are recorded with reasoning
Users can view merge history for any branch or task
Rollback is available for recent merges
Merge success rate metrics are tracked per project
user_stories: As a developer, I want to see how the AI resolved merge conflicts so that I can verify the decisions
As a team member, I want to rollback a problematic merge so that I can fix issues quickly

features.title: Customizable QA Validation Rules
features.description: Allow users to define custom validation rules for the QA pipeline beyond built-in checks. Support project-specific linting, test requirements, code coverage thresholds, and custom scripts.
features.rationale: Addresses competitor pain point of no validation in Copilot and aider. Strengthens our self-validating QA pipeline differentiator by making it adaptable to any project's standards.
acceptance_criteria: Users can add custom validation scripts to the QA pipeline
Project-specific linting rules are supported
Minimum test coverage thresholds can be configured
Custom validation failures block merge with clear error messages
Validation rules are stored per-project and version-controlled
user_stories: As a developer, I want to enforce my project's specific coding standards so that AI-generated code meets our requirements
As a team lead, I want to require 80% test coverage so that the AI writes comprehensive tests

features.title: Interactive Onboarding Wizard
features.description: Create a guided first-run experience that helps new users configure Turret, understand its capabilities, and complete their first successful autonomous task. Include interactive tutorials and example projects.
features.rationale: Reduces barrier to entry for new users. Addresses the learning curve that makes competitors like aider and Claude Code CLI less accessible. Critical for adoption and retention.
acceptance_criteria: New users are guided through API key setup and project initialization
Interactive tutorial explains key concepts (agents, worktrees, QA pipeline)
Example project is available for first task experimentation
Users can skip or return to onboarding at any time
Onboarding completion rate is tracked for optimization
user_stories: As a new user, I want step-by-step guidance so that I can start using Turret without reading documentation
As a developer trying Turret, I want to see a quick win so that I understand its value

features.title: Agent Confidence Metrics
features.description: Display confidence scores for agent actions and decisions. Show users when the AI is uncertain and might need guidance. Allow setting confidence thresholds for automatic vs. human-approval workflows.
features.rationale: Addresses competitor pain points requiring constant supervision. Provides a middle ground between full autonomy and constant oversight, building user trust in autonomous operations.
acceptance_criteria: Each agent decision displays a confidence score (0-100%)
Low-confidence actions are highlighted for user attention
Users can set threshold for automatic vs. manual approval
Confidence history is tracked to identify patterns
Explanation is provided for why confidence is low
user_stories: As a developer, I want to know when the AI is uncertain so that I can provide guidance on tricky decisions
As a power user, I want to auto-approve high-confidence actions so that routine work proceeds without interruption

features.title: Advanced Kanban Board Features
features.description: Enhance the Kanban board with filtering, labels, time tracking, dependencies visualization, and swimlanes. Add drag-and-drop prioritization and custom columns for different workflows.
features.rationale: Addresses competitor pain points for terminal-only tools lacking visual task management. Differentiates from CLI-based competitors and improves project management capabilities for complex multi-task workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Tasks can be filtered by status, label, assignee, or date
Custom labels with colors can be created and assigned
Time tracking shows estimated vs. actual duration
Task dependencies are visualized with connecting lines
Custom columns can be added for team-specific workflows
user_stories: As a developer, I want to filter tasks by status so that I can focus on what's in progress
As a project manager, I want to see task dependencies so that I can identify blockers

features.title: Agent Activity Dashboard
features.description: Create a comprehensive dashboard showing real-time agent activity, resource usage, success rates, and historical trends. Include metrics like tasks completed, tokens used, average task duration, and error rates.
features.rationale: Provides visibility into autonomous operations, helping users understand performance and optimize their workflows. Builds confidence in AI-powered development by showing exactly what's happening.
acceptance_criteria: Real-time view of active agents and their current tasks
Success/failure rates displayed with trend graphs
Token usage and API cost estimation visible
Average task completion time tracked per category
Historical data retained for 30+ days
user_stories: As a developer, I want to see agent success rates so that I can identify areas for improvement
As a budget-conscious user, I want to track token usage so that I can manage API costs

features.title: Task Templates Library
features.description: Create a library of reusable task templates for common development patterns (add feature, fix bug, refactor, write tests, update docs). Allow users to create and share custom templates.
features.rationale: Reduces time to start new tasks and ensures consistent approaches. Addresses user goal of reducing time from idea to merged code. Makes common operations one-click simple.
acceptance_criteria: Built-in templates for common task types (feature, bug, refactor, test, docs)
Templates pre-fill task description, acceptance criteria, and workflow settings
Users can create custom templates from completed tasks
Templates can be shared across projects
Template usage analytics help identify popular patterns
user_stories: As a developer, I want to start a bug fix with one click so that I don't have to write the same instructions every time
As a team member, I want to share our team's templates so that we maintain consistent practices

features.title: Smart Notification System
features.description: Implement a notification system that alerts users to task completions, failures, merge conflicts, and important agent decisions. Support desktop notifications, sound alerts, and integration with external tools.
features.rationale: Enables true fire-and-forget autonomous operation. Users can work on other things while agents run, getting notified only when attention is needed. Essential for parallel execution workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Desktop notifications for task completion/failure
Configurable notification types and sounds
Notification center shows recent events
Integration with Slack/Discord for team notifications
Quiet hours and Do Not Disturb mode supported
user_stories: As a developer, I want to be notified when tasks complete so that I can review and move on
As a team member, I want Slack notifications so that everyone stays informed

features.title: Workflow Automation Builder
features.description: Allow users to define automated workflows that chain multiple tasks together. Support conditional logic (if tests fail, run fix task), scheduled execution, and event triggers (new issue created, PR opened).
features.rationale: Addresses user goal of automating the entire build cycle. Enables complex multi-step automations without manual intervention. Differentiates from competitors that can only handle single tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Visual workflow builder with drag-and-drop task arrangement
Conditional logic supported (if/then/else based on outcomes)
Workflows can be triggered manually, scheduled, or by events
Workflow execution history is logged
Pre-built workflow templates for common patterns (CI/CD, review, release)
user_stories: As a developer, I want to automate our release process so that I can run it with one click
As a team lead, I want automatic bug fix attempts for new issues so that simple bugs get resolved quickly

features.title: Large Codebase Performance Optimization
features.description: Optimize indexing, search, and analysis for codebases with 100,000+ files. Implement incremental updates, smart caching, and parallel processing. Reduce memory footprint for large projects.
features.rationale: Critical for enterprise adoption and projects that grow over time. Addresses user pain point about context switching in large projects. Essential for working on large enterprise monorepos.
acceptance_criteria: Indexing 100,000 files completes in under 5 minutes
Incremental updates process only changed files
Memory usage stays under 2GB for typical operations
Search returns results in under 2 seconds for any query
Performance benchmarks are automated in CI
user_stories: As an enterprise developer, I want to use Turret on our large monorepo without performance issues
As a developer, I want quick project switching so that I can work across multiple repositories

features.title: Native Dependency Simplification
features.description: Remove or replace native dependencies (real_ladybug requiring C++ compiler) with pure JavaScript/Python alternatives or pre-built binaries. Make installation require only npm install with no external tools.
features.rationale: Reduces barrier to installation and improves cross-platform reliability. Critical for developer adoption who expect simple npm/pip install workflows. Addresses constraint of C++ compiler requirement.
acceptance_criteria: Installation succeeds with only Node.js and npm (no C++ compiler)
All platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux) work out of the box
Pre-built binaries are available for common platforms
Installation guide is simplified to 3 or fewer steps
CI tests installation on fresh machines without dev tools
user_stories: As a new user, I want to install Turret with npm install so that I don't need to set up build tools
As a Windows developer, I want installation to work without Visual Studio so that setup is fast

features.title: Status Tracking System Consolidation
features.description: Unify the multiple overlapping status tracking systems (Linear, internal) into a single source of truth. Provide sync adapters for external systems while maintaining internal consistency.
features.rationale: Reduces confusion, improves reliability, and simplifies maintenance. Ensures task status is always accurate and consistent across all views and integrations.
acceptance_criteria: Single internal status system is the source of truth
Linear integration syncs bidirectionally with internal status
Status changes are atomic and immediately consistent
Conflict resolution is automatic with user notification
Status history is retained for audit purposes
user_stories: As a developer, I want task status to be the same in Turret and Linear so that I'm not confused
As a team member, I want status updates to sync automatically so that I don't have to update multiple systems

features.title: Python Version Flexibility
features.description: Remove the Python 3.12 version lock by ensuring compatibility with Python 3.11-3.14. Create fallback mechanisms for dependencies lacking pre-built wheels on newer Python versions.
features.rationale: Improves user flexibility and future-proofing. Reduces installation friction for users with different Python versions installed. Addresses constraint of Python 3.12+ requirement.
acceptance_criteria: Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13 are supported
Fallback to source compilation if pre-built wheels unavailable
Clear error messages for unsupported Python versions
CI tests on all supported Python versions
Documentation clearly states version requirements
user_stories: As a developer, I want to use my existing Python installation so that I don't have to manage multiple versions
As a team member, I want to use the latest Python for security updates

features.title: Plugin System Architecture
features.description: Design and implement an extension/plugin system that allows community contributions. Support custom agents, validators, integrations, and UI components. Provide plugin SDK and documentation.
features.rationale: Enables ecosystem growth and community contributions. Differentiates from closed-source alternatives like Devin by being extensible and transparent. Allows users to customize for their needs.
acceptance_criteria: Plugin SDK is documented and easy to use
Plugins can add custom agents, validators, and UI panels
Plugin security is enforced (sandboxing, permissions)
Plugin marketplace or registry exists for discovery
Official example plugins demonstrate capabilities
user_stories: As a developer, I want to create a custom agent for my domain so that Turret handles specialized tasks
As a community member, I want to share my plugins so that others can benefit

features.title: Integration Marketplace
features.description: Create a marketplace for integrations with external tools (IDEs, CI/CD, project management, communication). Include official integrations for popular tools and community-contributed ones.
features.rationale: Expands Turret's reach and reduces friction for teams using various tools. Addresses user pain point about parallel development coordination by integrating with existing workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Integration catalog shows available connections
Official integrations for GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Slack
One-click installation for integrations
Integration health monitoring and troubleshooting
Community can submit integrations for review
user_stories: As a developer, I want to connect Turret to our Jira so that tasks sync automatically
As a team, we want Slack integration so that everyone gets notified of progress

features.title: Team Collaboration Features
features.description: Add features for team collaboration: shared configurations, memory synchronization, task assignment, and real-time collaboration on projects. Support team roles and permissions.
features.rationale: Addresses user goal of parallel development without manual coordination. Enables teams to leverage Turret together rather than as individuals. Essential for enterprise adoption.
acceptance_criteria: Team members can share project configurations
Memory Layer can be shared across team
Tasks can be assigned to specific team members
Role-based permissions control access
Activity feed shows team-wide progress
user_stories: As a team lead, I want to share our project standards so that everyone's agents follow the same conventions
As a developer, I want to see what my teammates' agents are working on so that we don't duplicate effort

features.title: Cloud Sync for Settings and Memory
features.description: Implement optional cloud synchronization for user settings, preferences, and Memory Layer data. Allow users to access their configuration from any machine while keeping data secure.
features.rationale: Enables seamless multi-device workflows. Addresses user pain point of context loss when switching machines. Complements Memory Layer by making it truly persistent across devices.
acceptance_criteria: Settings sync across devices with user account
Memory Layer can optionally sync to cloud
End-to-end encryption for all synced data
Offline mode works with local cache
Users can export all data at any time
user_stories: As a developer, I want my settings to sync between work and home machines so that I don't have to reconfigure
As a privacy-conscious user, I want encryption so that my data stays private

features.title: Advanced Conflict Analysis
features.description: Replace placeholder TODO checks in conflict analysis with real implementation. Provide semantic understanding of conflicts, not just line-based detection. Analyze code structure, variable renames, and functional changes.
features.rationale: Addresses known technical gap (placeholder TODOs in conflict analysis). Current placeholder implementation limits conflict resolution quality. Semantic analysis enables smarter resolutions and reduces developer intervention.
acceptance_criteria: Conflict analysis identifies semantic conflicts (not just line conflicts)
Analysis provides context about conflicting changes (intent, scope)
Resolution suggestions are ranked by confidence
Handles complex scenarios: rename + modify, structural changes
Tests verify correct handling of various conflict types
user_stories: As a developer, I want conflicts analyzed semantically so the AI makes smarter resolution choices
As a developer, I want to understand why conflicts occurred so I can approve resolutions confidently

features.title: Health Monitoring Email Alerts
features.description: Implement email notification system for health monitoring. Alert developers when tasks fail, agents error, or system health degrades. Addresses the TODO in health monitor code.
features.rationale: Addresses known technical gap (TODO in health monitor). Critical for enabling true delegation - developers need to know when to intervene without constantly checking. Enables truly autonomous operation.
acceptance_criteria: Email alerts sent on task failure with error context
Configurable alert thresholds (e.g., 3 consecutive failures)
SMTP configuration UI in settings
Test email functionality to verify configuration
Opt-out available per notification type
user_stories: As a developer, I want email alerts when tasks fail so I don't need to constantly monitor Turret
As a developer, I want configurable thresholds so I'm not overwhelmed by notifications

features.title: Enhanced Git Worktree UI
features.description: Visual diff viewer, branch comparison, and easy merge/discard controls for worktree-isolated changes. See exactly what AI changed before merging with file-by-file review.
features.rationale: Git worktree isolation is a key safety differentiator that no competitor offers. Better UI for reviewing and merging increases confidence in the safety system and makes adoption easier.
acceptance_criteria: Visual diff viewer shows all changes in worktree
File-by-file review with accept/reject per file
Branch comparison view between worktree and main
One-click merge with conflict preview
Discard all changes with confirmation
user_stories: As a developer, I want to visually review worktree changes so I approve only what I want
As a developer, I want easy merge controls so worktree-to-main is seamless

features.title: Autonomous Recovery from Failures
features.description: When agents fail, automatically attempt alternative approaches based on error analysis. Learn from failures to improve future attempts. Store failure patterns in Memory Layer.
features.rationale: Reduces need for human intervention when tasks fail. Makes autonomous execution more robust and moves closer to true delegation. Addresses the critical pain point of AI tools requiring constant supervision.
acceptance_criteria: Failed tasks trigger automated retry with different approach
Error patterns are analyzed to select recovery strategy
Maximum retry attempts configurable
Failure patterns stored in Memory Layer for future avoidance
Clear reporting on recovery attempts and outcomes
user_stories: As a developer, I want tasks to self-recover from failures so I don't need to intervene often
As a developer, I want Turret to learn from failures so the same errors don't repeat

features.title: Multi-Agent Task Coordination
features.description: Improve coordination between parallel agents. Implement task dependency awareness, resource locking, and conflict prevention when multiple agents work on related files.
features.rationale: 12-agent parallel execution is a unique differentiator that no competitor offers. Better coordination prevents conflicts and maximizes the productivity benefit of parallel execution.
acceptance_criteria: Agents are aware of files being modified by other agents
File-level locking prevents simultaneous edits to same file
Dependency graph ensures prerequisite tasks complete first
Coordination overhead is minimal (< 5% of execution time)
Clear UI indication of agent coordination status
user_stories: As a developer, I want parallel agents to coordinate so they don't create conflicts
As a developer, I want to run 12 agents simultaneously without manual coordination

features.title: GitHub/GitLab Integration
features.description: Deep integration with GitHub/GitLab: create PRs from completed tasks, respond to issues, automate CI triggers. Enable end-to-end automation from issue to merged PR.
features.rationale: Addresses the secondary persona of open-source maintainers. Enables true end-to-end automation from issue creation to merged pull request. Reduces context switching.
acceptance_criteria: One-click PR creation from merged worktree
Automatic PR description generation from task context
GitHub issue import as Kanban tasks
GitLab support for MR creation
Webhook support for CI/CD triggers
user_stories: As an open-source maintainer, I want issues to become tasks automatically
As a developer, I want PRs created with good descriptions from task context

features.title: Custom Agent Roles
features.description: Configure specialized agent personas (Security Auditor, Performance Optimizer, Documentation Writer). Agents with domain expertise for specific tasks bring different perspectives.
features.rationale: Leverages multi-agent capability for specialized expertise. Different personas can bring different perspectives to code review and generation. Enables domain-specific optimization.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-built roles: Security, Performance, Documentation, Testing
Custom role creation with specific system prompts
Role assignment to specific task types
Multi-role review (e.g., both security and performance check)
Role effectiveness tracking
user_stories: As a developer, I want a Security Auditor agent to review my code for vulnerabilities
As a developer, I want to create custom roles for my team's specific needs

features.title: Enterprise SSO & RBAC
features.description: Single Sign-On integration (SAML, OIDC) and Role-Based Access Control for enterprise deployments. Control who can access what in team environments.
features.rationale: Required for enterprise adoption. Large organizations need SSO and access controls for security compliance. Opens market for larger organizations.
acceptance_criteria: SAML and OIDC SSO support
Role definitions: Admin, Developer, Viewer
Project-level access controls
Audit logging for compliance
Integration with enterprise identity providers
user_stories: As an IT admin, I want SSO so employees use corporate credentials
As a security officer, I want audit logs for compliance requirements

known_gaps_addressed: Email alerts for health monitoring (TODO in health monitor)
